import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_37/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_37/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# According to operation_history: JOIN on ["business_id","business_id"],["date","date"]
# Join df0 and df1 on business_id and date
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, how='inner', on=['business_id', 'date'])

# Reorder and cast columns to match target schema:
# Target Schema: ['business_id': integer, 'Score': float, 'date': integer, 'type': string, 'ViolationTypeID': integer, 'risk_category': string, 'description': string]

# Ensure correct dtypes:
df_joined['business_id'] = df_joined['business_id'].astype(int)
df_joined['Score'] = df_joined['Score'].astype(float)
df_joined['date'] = df_joined['date'].astype(int)
df_joined['type'] = df_joined['type'].astype(str)
df_joined['ViolationTypeID'] = df_joined['ViolationTypeID'].astype(int)
df_joined['risk_category'] = df_joined['risk_category'].astype(str)
df_joined['description'] = df_joined['description'].astype(str)

# Select columns in target schema order
df_target = df_joined[['business_id', 'Score', 'date', 'type', 'ViolationTypeID', 'risk_category', 'description']]

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_37/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
